title: Vice-President to visit Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu on September 11-12
body_text:
Vice-President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan will undertake his maiden visit to the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu on September 11-12, 2026.
During his visit, the Vice-President will attend a public function at Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Government College, Silvassa.
The Vice-President will also visit key institutions and development initiatives in the Union Territory, including Swami Vivekananda Vidya Mandir and the NAMO Medical Education & Research Institute in Silvassa, and the recently inaugurated Namo Hospital in Daman.
He will also visit important tourism and waterfront development sites, including Daman Night Market, Ramsetu Seafront and Namopath Seafront.
